label: D1 after a reward, early in the episode, while the agent leans moderately toward a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1. It never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1s, or on penalty steps. Nearly all activations come from episode trials 2-21 (none after trial ~25). Almost all are on a2 trials (the previous choice and the upcoming choice are both a2), mostly in episodes that started with S2 good, and the model policy logit sits in a moderate a2-leaning band (choice between -4.4 and -1.5; value about 7.5-7.7). So it marks a rewarded D1 in the early-episode regime while the agent is committed, but not strongly, to a2. Inside a window the magnitude falls over consecutive rewarded D1s (e.g. 1.0, 0.92, 0.84, 0.78), so it looks like a slowly decaying early-episode signal, gated by reward. A simpler observed alternative, D1 & in_rew==1 & action==2 & prev_action!=1 & ep_trial 2-19 (action is the upcoming choice of the agent itself), gives dev F1 0.71. The recorded choice-band version gives dev F1 0.785 with mass recall 0.99. Precision stays near 0.6-0.67 because many rewarded early a2 D1s fall below threshold, apparently depending on how far into the decay the step is.
